- [`verification.py`](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round7/argon_h3h4_review1/verification.py), [`verification_output.json`](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round7/argon_h3h4_review1/verification_output.json), and [`verification_output.txt`](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round7/argon_h3h4_review1/verification_output.txt) — Self-contained verification script executed via `uv run python` and its saved outputs.

---

### Summary of Verdicts & Key Audit Findings

#### 1. Hypothesis 3 (`H3`): `SUPPORTED_WITH_BOUNDS`
- **Sampling Replay & Quota Closure Verified:** Independent replay in [`verification.py`](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round7/argon_h3h4_review1/verification.py#L43-L250) confirms that the 1,500-genome SMAG draw (`seed=20261014` from 40,039 IDs in [`smag_catalogue_40039_ids.txt`](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round7/snapshots/h3_completed/smag_catalogue_40039_ids.txt)) and the three 2,055-genome GEM draws (`seeds 20261014, 20261015, 20261016` from 52,515 IDs in [`gem_catalogue_52515_ids.txt`](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round7/snapshots/h3_completed/gem_catalogue_52515_ids.txt)) match [`smag_genome_manifest.tsv`](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round7/snapshots/h3_completed/smag_genome_manifest.tsv) and all six `gem_{harmonized,published}_manifest_seed*.tsv` files with 100% identity. Across all 7 matched database pairs in [`matching_closure_audit.tsv`](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round7/snapshots/h3_completed/matching_closure_audit.tsv#L2-L8), 5-bin sums equal `matched_proteins` (`4,210,592` proteins and `1,295,970,055` aa per arm in primary `harmonized_seed20261014`; `4,185,525` proteins and `0` post-matching shared sequences in `harmonized_seed20261014_no_overlap`).
- **Full-Census & Length-Stratified Arithmetic Verified:** All 14 `.dmnd.sig.json` and 16 `.m8.sig.json` signature files, all 16 rows of [`matched_full_census_summary.tsv`](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round7/snapshots/h3_completed/matched_full_census_summary.tsv#L2-L17), and all 80 rows of [`matched_length_stratified_results.tsv`](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round7/snapshots/h3_completed/matched_length_stratified_results.tsv#L2-L81) close exactly ($a+b+c+d = 106,042$ per arm). Primary `harmonized_seed20261014` yields Dark SMAG hit rate **28.35%** ($30,064/106,042$) vs GEM **9.81%** ($10,399/106,042$), paired $\hat{\Delta} = +18.54$ percentage points ($b/c = 9.25$), vs Control **93.99%** vs **90.89%**, $\hat{\Delta} = +3.10$ percentage points ($b/c = 2.56$).
- **Required Inferential Bounds:**
  1. **Single fixed SMAG draw & GEM comparator-draw range:** All 8 pairs reuse the single fixed 1,500-genome SMAG draw (`seed=20261014`, 3.75% of SMAG); the three GEM draws (`2,055` genomes each via fixed rule $\lceil 4.5\times 10^6 \times 1.05 / 2300 \rceil = 2,055$ in [`03_fetch_and_call_gem.py`](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reproducibility/darkmatter/round7_analyses/h3_references/scripts/03_fetch_and_call_gem.py#L412-L418)) quantify GEM comparator-draw sensitivity ($\hat{\Delta} = +18.54\%, +16.83\%, +16.91\%$), not SMAG-draw uncertainty or biological replication.
  2. **End-to-end caller-plus-matching & length-standardization bounds:** Switching GEM between harmonized Pyrodigal v3.7.1 and published Prodigal v2.6.3 changes the 1-aa quota support (`4,210,592` vs `4,216,518` proteins in seed 20261014) and is an end-to-end caller-plus-matching sensitivity. Direct standardization of Dark queries to the shorter Control length distribution still yields Dark $\hat{\Delta} = +17.52\%$ (and Control reweighted to Dark length weights yields $+2.65\%$), confirming the contrast is not a length-distribution artifact.

#### 2. Hypothesis 4 (`H4`): `REVISE`
- **CPU Paired Census & 40-Row Stratum Table Verified:** Independent recomputation of all 40 rows (8 strata $\times$ 5 tiers) and 27 integer columns of [`v7_stratum_census.tsv`](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round7/root_checks/h4_outputs_preclosure/v7_stratum_census.tsv#L1-L41) from [`v7_model_summaries.tsv`](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round7/root_checks/h4_outputs_preclosure/v7_model_summaries.tsv) (5,851 models), [`v7_region_evaluations.tsv`](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round7/root_checks/h4_outputs_preclosure/v7_region_evaluations.tsv) (7,773 regions), and [`v7_full5851_cropped_regions_manifest.tsv`](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round7/root_checks/h4_outputs_preclosure/v7_full5851_cropped_regions_manifest.tsv) (7,934 rows) yields **0 mismatches**:
  - `K_local_pdb` ($N=849$, 812 eligible, 37 no-region): Tier 1 WC matched **64/849 (7.54%)** $\to$ Crop matched **692/849 (81.51% unconditional; 85.22% region-eligible)**; WC-unmatched recovery **633/785 (80.64% unconditional; 84.40% eligible)**; 100% invariant across Tiers 0–4.
  - `K_local_all` ($N=936$, 896 eligible): Tier 1 WC matched **67/936 (7.16%)** $\to$ Crop matched **739/936 (78.95% unconditional; 82.48% eligible)**.
  - `K_dual_none` ($N=95$, 88 eligible): Tier 1 WC matched **0/95 (0.0%)** $\to$ Crop matched **36/95 (37.89% unconditional; 40.91% eligible)** across Tiers 0–4 (+43.61 percentage-point unconditional difference below `K_local_pdb`, risk ratio 2.15).
  - `Controls` ($N=3,013$, 3,000 eligible): Unconditional crop match rates are **96.32%** (Tier 0), **95.88%** (Tier 1), **94.32%** (Tier 2), **93.69%** (Tier 3), and **92.80%** (Tier 4).
- **Critical Refutation of Five Errors in Flash's [`DIAGNOSIS.md`](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round7/h4_tm_anomaly/DIAGNOSIS.md) and [`findings.json`](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round7/h4_tm_anomaly/findings.json):**
  1. Flash falsely claims Control Tier 0/1 match retention is 100% and cites a non-existent `94.75%` Tier 0/1 unconditional crop match rate (actual: **96.32%** at Tier 0 and **95.88%** at Tier 1).
  2. Flash repeatedly cites `5,851 cropped regions` instead of **7,773 cropped regions**.
  3. Flash reports `(query, tier)` tuple counts summed across 5 tiers in [`exclusion_sensitivity_diff.json`](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round7/h4_tm_anomaly/exclusion_sensitivity_diff.json) (`57, 160, 10, 209, 329, 41, 25, 25`) as unique models/regions; our audit proves the actual unique entity counts are **25, 78, 4** WC models and **93, 150, 15** cropped regions (affecting **9** unique models in Tiers 2–4, and **0** at Tiers 0–1).
  4. Flash falsely claims dark models are "mathematically impossible" to be affected by the [`structureconvertalis.cpp:898`](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round7/h4_tm_anomaly/source/structureconvertalis.cpp#L898) missing `+ 1` bug (`min(qspan - 1, tspan - 1)`). In fact, dividing by $L_{\text{span}} - 1$ inflates *all* `alntmscore` values by $\sim L_{\text{span}} / (L_{\text{span}} - 1)$. While primary H4 match classification uses `qTM >= 0.5` (which is exact and unaffected), **historical stratum definitions** (`K_local_pdb`, `K_local_afdb_only`, `K_dual_none`) and [`manuscript/main.tex`](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/manuscript/main.tex#L328-L339) local-match counts use `alnTM >= 0.5`.
  5. Flash's proposal to relax verification bounds to `alnTM <= 1.0200` is improper; multiplying `alntm` by $(L_{\text{span}}-1)/L_{\text{span}}$ across all 2,194 anomalous rows in [`tm_anomaly_queries.tsv`](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round7/h4_tm_anomaly/tm_anomaly_queries.tsv) reduces the maximum rescaled `alntm` from `1.014` to **0.998008** (100% $\le 1.0$).
- **Exact Empirical Bound on Historical `alnTM >= 0.5` Stratum Assignment:** In [`verification_output.json`](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round7/argon_h3h4_review1/verification_output.json#L1612-L1676), we show that across all 849 `K_local_pdb` models, only **5 models (0.59%)** have `hist_pdb_alntm` in $[0.5, 0.5051]$ ($L_{\text{span}} \ge 100$ aa) and **14 models (1.65%)** lie in $[0.5, 0.5102]$ ($L_{\text{span}} \ge 50$ aa); excluding all 14 boundary models changes the `K_local_pdb` Tier 1 crop match rate by **-0.07 percentage points** (`81.51%` $\to$ `81.44%`). In current Round 7 PDB searches, exact `qspan` rescaling crosses $0.5$ for only **1/2,838** dark WC models and **14/3,648** dark cropped regions.
- **ORIX GPU Sensitivity (`315233`) Status:** Raw GPU execution on `freecycle-h200` (`--gpu 1 --prefilter-mode 1`) completed (`task 0 restart 2` WC, `task 1 restart 0` crop), but uses ungapped prefiltering (ignoring `-s 9.5`), runs the same Foldseek `10-941cd33` commit (so `alnTM > 1` is unchanged), and remains **PENDING** Root's raw hit-level CPU-vs-GPU comparison and 5-tier post-processing.
